Updated disposition under the user’s explicit cross-Indo-Aryan policy: link this supported etymon despite unresolved inheritance versus intra-Indo-Aryan borrowing. The reflex edge records etymological family affiliation provisionally; it does not establish uninterrupted inheritance or an immediate donor. Prior hold: CDIAL 142 distinguishes inherited western āch- forms from Punjabi > Hindi acchā; the survey lect’s immediate borrowing route is not established.
